propositions: The docs and the review_plan docstring falsely claim a bug short-circuits to an exempt PASS with runner=exempt.
In actual code, a bug is reviewed under the bug review tier (light advisory: DET floor plus necessity probe) and can be coached but is never blocked.
Only session_log, code_review, and identity types are gate-exempt with runner=exempt and no review.
The docs conflate two distinct exemption axes: the CLI claim-time bug exemption in rebar._commands.gates versus whether the plan-review gate reviews a bug.
The fix is documentation-only with no behavior change, keeping tests/unit/test_bug_review_tier.py passing.
